en.title: Tag Questions with Nu
en.summary: Learn how to raise your pitch for tag questions with nu in Romanian.

sections.title: The sound
paragraphs:
You can add a small word at the end of a sentence.
Intonation is the way your voice goes up and down over a whole sentence.
Pitch is how high or low your voice sounds.
Your pitch rises at the end.
You ask the other person to agree with you.
Listen to (Vii, nu?) /ˈvi.i nu/.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs:
Start the sentence at a normal level.
Let your voice stay steady across the first words.
A syllable is one beat of a word.
Make a tiny pause before the last word.
Say the final syllable with a rising pitch.
Your voice rises high at the end.
This rise shows that you want an answer.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs:
Look for a comma before the final short word.
The comma marks a very short pause.
Next, you see a question mark at the end.
The question mark shows that your voice must climb.
Read (Vii, nu?) /ˈvi.i nu/ with a rise at the end.
It means you are coming, are you not.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs:
Do not lower your pitch at the end.
A falling pitch turns the question into a plain statement.
Do not forget the pause before the final word.
Always raise your voice on the ending.
Lift your pitch cleanly when you say (Vii, nu?) /ˈvi.i nu/.
